organization.description: The organization ID in which the log bucket should be created. This should be the numeric organization ID.
organization.rationale: Proper organization specification ensures log buckets are created in the correct organizational context with appropriate access controls.

location.description: The location of the log bucket. This can be a global location or a specific region. Supported locations include 'global', 'us-central1', 'europe-west1', etc.
location.rationale: Location selection affects data residency and compliance with regional data protection regulations.

bucket_id.description: The name of the log bucket. Must be unique within the organization and location. Bucket IDs must contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.
bucket_id.rationale: Proper bucket naming helps identify security-related log buckets and maintain organizational standards.

description.description: A description of the log bucket, which can help identify its purpose and contents. Maximum length is 8000 characters.
description.rationale: Descriptions provide documentation but don't directly impact security configuration.
description.compliant: Stores security audit logs for compliance and monitoring purposes

retention_days.description: The number of days that log entries in the bucket should be retained. Must be ≥ 1 day. If not set, logs are retained indefinitely.
retention_days.rationale: Appropriate retention periods ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and security investigation needs.

index_configs.description: Configuration for indexed fields in the log bucket, which enables faster searching and filtering of log entries.
index_configs.rationale: Proper indexing of security-relevant fields enables efficient security monitoring and incident investigation.

field_path.description: Note that some paths are automatically indexed, and other paths are not eligible for indexing. See [indexing documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/analyze/custom-index) for details. The path to the field in the log entry to index.
field_path.rationale: Indexing security-relevant fields enables efficient security monitoring and threat detection.

type.description: The type of data in the indexed field. This determines how the field is indexed and queried. Possible values include 'STRING', 'INTEGER', 'BOOLEAN', 'DOUBLE', 'TIMESTAMP'.
type.rationale: Field type should match the actual data type but doesn't directly impact security.
